errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена с числови стойности в трилиони долара (за пазара) и проценти (за ръста).
errors.evidence: The Y-axis is labeled with numerical values from 0.00 to 18.00. It is not labeled with units (trillion dollars or percent). These units are found in the legend and as data labels.

errors.text_span: Диапазонът на стойностите за пазара е от 0,00 до 18,00 (в трилиони долара), а за ръста – от 0 до 18,00 (в проценти).
errors.evidence: The chart has a single Y-axis with a scale from 0.00 to 18.00, which corresponds to the market volume in trillion dollars. The growth percentages (9%-16%) are data labels placed on the chart and do not correspond to this Y-axis scale.

errors.text_span: Тя е във формата на стълбови диаграми със сини стълби, които се увеличават по оста X.
errors.evidence: The chart shows a blue area chart for the B2B market, not a bar chart ("стълбови диаграми").
The orange line in the chart does not have any markers. The data points are indicated by percentage labels only.

errors.text_span: с високо ниво на ръст от 2017 до 2021
errors.evidence: This oversimplifies the trend, which includes a dip in growth from 10% in 2018 to 9% in 2019. Also, there is no growth data shown for 2017.
